missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Автомобиль' is a masculine soft-sign noun staying in the nominative as the subject. 'Дорогой' is the agreeing masculine adjective, reinforced by 'очень'.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Автомобиль' is the accusative direct object of 'купил', identical to the nominative for this inanimate masculine noun. 'Новый' agrees, and 'вчера' sets the time.
Strategic focus: Genitive of absence. 'Автомобиля' takes the genitive after 'нет' to express that none is owned. 'Своего' agrees in the masculine genitive.
Strategic focus: Prepositional of means. 'Автомобиле' is the prepositional after 'на' to show what they travel in. 'Красном' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Dative of direction. 'Автомобилю' takes the dative after 'к' to show motion toward. 'Старому' agrees in the masculine dative, and 'подошёл' gives the motion.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Автомобилем' is the instrumental after 'любуются', which governs that case. 'Спортивным' agrees in the masculine instrumental.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural. 'Автомобили' is the nominative plural subject of 'стоят', taking the soft -и ending. 'Дорогие' agrees, and 'на стоянке' gives the location.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after quantity. 'Автомобилей' is the genitive plural after 'много', taking the -ей ending for soft masculine nouns. 'Старых' agrees in the plural.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Автомобиле' is the prepositional after 'о' to express the topic. 'Новом' agrees in the masculine prepositional, and 'говорили' introduces discussion.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with location. 'Автомобиль' is nominative as the subject of 'стоит'. 'Перед домом' uses the instrumental to give the position of the car.
